text: {"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["the brother's speech 'baax leila Zucune... tubx yan lay à lolob la kilob cu tabzechobe, catu pathechob ichil uyabal numya' (What is this, brother? Where has your strength / beauty gone that others envied... where are the flowers and pleasures that deceived you and left you in suffering)", "'ua à cħaphal cu betice kahez ɔocan à manzic u yanalob àzab nohob' (if it is your illness that does this...)", "the clause that the sick man sent for his younger brother ('tu tuchi tah paibil ú yicin caat tali')", "'max ù caxtic ù ɔacal' (he sought no remedy)", "'lay ctum ù yiɔine y ùyabal alabolal cu chichcuntic ùyol tan yalic ti caxi Yumbil y Mehenbil tan yilic ù chichil à puczikal tu xotah â kinil tu nukul tu betah' (then his younger brother, with great hope, strengthening his heart, said: perhaps Father and Son, seeing your hard heart, cut short your days as you deserved)", "'tohpulan à keban' (your sins confessed) is folded in only vaguely"], "added": ["\"He fixed his gaze firmly until dawn came.\"", "\"whom no one resembles\""], "mistranslated": ["u Utzcinticob (to heal/save them) -> 'for the sake of honoring them'", "hunk ꝑ u Cilich kikel ... tu tzem (a handful of his holy blood from his breast) -> 'a drop of holy blood fell from his side'", "u lohul ù chucanob / sinners -> 'your captives'", "talanil kikel (precious blood) -> 'my coming blood'", "hach noh pahzubtal (great condemnation) -> 'great shame'", "tu cantah ti ù Zucun (told his brother) -> 'learned from his elder brother'", "ah ɔaiatzil (merciful one) -> 'the punisher'", "Zatestí (forgives it) -> 'destroy it'", "uy in tħan (in the brother's mouth) is presented without a speaker, and the sense becomes confused", "paie humpel Padre (call a priest) -> 'Pay a Padre'", "tohpultic (confess) -> 'set right'", "Ualkezan (repentant) -> 'rise up quickly'", "ca tu tohpultah ù kebanob (he confessed his sins) -> 'who set right his sins'", "Ciumil (the Lord, i.e. Communion) -> 'received the Lord' (only loosely rendered)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["\"dressed in white\" (the source only has 'y ú zac', which continues on the next page; 'dressed' is anticipated)"], "mistranslated": ["chucanob (captives/those caught) -> 'sinners' (a loose reading)", "kahez ɔocan à manzic u yanalob àzab nohob -> 'you have had enough of other things already' (the sense is uncertain)", "hele tan yn pactcech hach Zahbentzil -> 'looking dreadful' (acceptable, though some nuance is lost)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B renders the whole page coherently and accurately, including the brother's speeches, while A leaves out most of the brother's dialogue, adds content that is not in the source, and gets several key terms wrong (such as 'punisher' for merciful and 'pay a Padre')."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["'ù ꝑel mehen': 'only' Son is rendered just as 'the Son'", "'tu caꝑel akabe tali tun tii': small connective detail flattened"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["bakbakcixan (uncertain sense, likely lewdness/vice) -> 'gambling' (doubtful)", "maix tan û Kantal û yatal tauol (nor will sorrow/grief come to your heart in time) -> 'you will find no time in your heart'", "in chiic otzil (I pitied the poor/wretched) -> 'I took pity' (object dropped)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["the younger brother as the one who warns and prays (merged into the elder brother)", "'he left him' (ca tu Zitah)"], "added": ["\"Do you know me? Who are you?\"", "\"in torn garments\"", "\"of God\" (in 'Son of God')", "\"so that the evil of his way was twisted, then went out\""], "mistranslated": ["tan â manbalcuntic in tħan (you scorn my words) -> 'I see you reflecting on my words'", "maix tan û Kantal û yatal tauol (nor will grief reach your heart) -> 'Nor is it needful that you weep much'", "Cichcelem (beautiful/handsome) -> 'very holy'", "u yocol ichil ù Uay (enter his room) -> 'enter into his sleep... in a dream'", "ca tu nucah ti (he answered him) -> 'He answered me'", "tan à manbalcuntic û cici tħan Dioz (you scorn God's good word) -> 'as you ponder the sweet word of God'", "ca tu Zama huba (he vanished) -> 'the sick man shook himself and sat up'", "noc kixob (crown/covering of thorns) -> 'torn garments'", "tu tzem (his breast) -> 'his side'", "ma hakotzil ca chacanacen (no wonder I look like him) -> 'I am not different; we are alike'", "tumen tech cauoltic (because you will it) -> 'because of what you desire' (roughly ok) / ichticilyà (terrified) -> 'within himself'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is a close, coherent rendering with only a few small slips, while B garbles who does what, reverses key meanings (scorn becomes reflecting, vanishing becomes sitting up) and makes up details such as 'torn garments'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["baibic minan yet ꝑiz û yutzile (there is nothing equal to its goodness) -> 'Just as his goodness has no end'", "ma uchac û haual t huntenile (cannot cease at all / once and for all) -> 'can never cease' (slight smoothing)", "hele û chichnile (the younger one) -> 'One of them'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["Kat (clay idols) as object of worship", "mali yinac Caan y lume y anili Dioz Cilich oxile (before heaven and earth existed, God the Holy Trinity already was)"], "added": ["everything that passes beneath heaven and earth", "as it is not yet made clear"], "mistranslated": ["ca yuchul hahibe (it does not truly come about) -> 'the truth is this'", "Hach paibentziliix c ocziceex ti c oleex (it is very necessary that we take to heart) -> 'You must believe with great firmness in your hearts in this Father'", "tubx yan â nateex ta kulticeex Kat, ua û yanal baal (where is your sense in worshipping clay or other things) -> 'where is your understanding in your worship, if there is anything'", "â hanonexe (while eating) -> 'while awake'", "minan yet ꝑiz û yutzile ... topzazil utial tulacal baal (nothing equals its goodness; cannot fail since it is the beginning of all things) -> 'it cannot be deceived, for deceit concerns all things'", "hele û chichnile hach ɔibol ti lay Cambale y ti û tiblilob bel matan û tacbezuba (the younger was very eager for study and good ways and did not involve himself) -> 'Now the strength of it is written very plainly in that study and in its evil ways, as it is not yet made clear'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is complete and accurate apart from a few small slips, while B misreads several passages, leaves out the clay idols and the statement that God existed before heaven and earth, and garbles the final sentence."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["cu yuchul lay ú cha campahal ta Uuyahexloe (this teaching/learning you have heard takes place) -> 'these appearances you have heard about took place'", "citaci u pacticloe (an uncertain phrase, roughly 'when it was …/looked upon') -> 'When it was formed' (interpretive)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["caix bahun upic tanil ua c Ualkezicex cbati (however many they are, if we truly repent) -> 'Each time that we turn back, let us do so truly'", "cahlicob ychil ekmayil ú pictanil uinicoob (the multitude of men live in darkness) -> 'They live in the darkness of the multitude of people'", "zeb ú lublob ti tumtabale (they quickly fall into temptation) -> 'they hasten to fall into ruin'", "ú kazil be licil u pailob tumen Cizin (the evil road along which the devil leads them) -> 'the evil of the way, while they are held captive by Cizin'", "tic ahualob (from our enemies) -> 'from the lords of the enemy'", "tan u yilic ... ɔoc ú lublob ti keban (seeing that they had fallen into sin) -> 'had regard for us after the sin'", "citaci u pacticloe -> 'as she waited'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both translations are complete, but A renders the darkness, temptation and repentance passages correctly, while B misreads several Maya clauses."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["le pacatóob cú kalicuƀaóob (the glances it shuts / keeps closed) -> 'the glances it allows itself'", "ú káatóob ú ɔálpach ti le niƀolalóob payalchióob tu tiƀlilóob (they want to leave behind / let go of their pious devotions) -> 'if out of habit it still keeps up the pious devotions of its forebears' (uncertain passage, sense likely reversed)", "cú cħiƀil y leti kinil, le mazuƀtalil (it is bitten by / takes on the world's days and vanity) -> 'The world, vanity...' (sense loosened)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 1, "omitted": ["the sense that the soul loses its strength for good works day by day and must be dragged along", "the comparison of the arm healing quickly with a few pains and days"], "added": ["\"still wounded, he has not yet set it right\"", "\"I ask my children\"", "\"the burial of the elders of that life\"", "\"If they ask for their cover before the poor and the beggars at their doors\"", "\"On the fourth day you take hold of the truth\"", "\"as if you were one hand\"", "\"the instruments of the good works that give off the evil smell\""], "mistranslated": ["ua leyli náapzahàanil má tu heɔcuntic (whether experience itself does not confirm it) -> 'whether, still wounded, he has not yet set it right'", "humpel chunché xmà ùuyah ti le peccuolahóob ti le Cáan (a tree trunk deaf to Heaven's inspirations) -> 'a foundation without feeling toward those who stir the heart of the Lord'", "cach téex humpel kaƀ (you broke an arm) -> 'as if you were one hand'", "tu canil helé (in a short time) -> 'On the fourth day'", "anaci ú tħancóoƀ tu zeƀlacil Jesu-Cristo (would it not call Jesus Christ at once) -> 'It has remained in its words before Jesus Christ'", "ah nucteil ti le Sinagoga (ruler of the synagogue) -> 'high priest'", "chac uyenil (great inflammation) -> 'great sickness'; cuchil cimpahané tu zatahuƀa ú chucáan (the dying part lost its strength) -> 'In the hour of the dead one, he lost his guilt'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the moral argument and the broken-arm comparison closely with only a few small slips, while B misreads much of the Maya and comes out largely incoherent with invented content."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["u yah ɔaiatzilich (sense uncertain) -> 'his merciful face', a possible over-reading", "alabolal ah zatalob 'hope of the lost' -> 'glory of the lost'", "tan à chaibenzic u yabal tibil beob ichil lay kinlae (unclear, probably 'do/seek many good works in these days') -> 'ask pardon of the many good people of this time'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["utial t metnal: the sentence was to hell", "hebax cu ɔanuc ta baal toneex: 'whatever is given to us'"], "added": ["'He answered me'", "'so that the way be known'"], "mistranslated": ["u yah ɔaiatzilich 'his merciful face' -> 'was filled with awe'", "uchac baca yintal u hol caan, a question ('how can the door of heaven be opened...?') -> a wish ('Let the door of heaven be opened')", "bin baca u helbez lay xotob kin ti ma xulumte kakob 'will they change this sentence of endless fire?' -> 'let these drops... avail, so that the way be known'", "yinac tech chich olal max à capel oltic 'take heart, do not doubt' -> 'Be firm, for whoever seeks the redemption'", "u mukob u kabilob tohpulkeban 'the power of the medicine of confession' -> 'hidden powers of true penitents'", "cu ualkezic u yich y u zentencia 'turns back his face and sentence' -> 'raises his face and his sentence'", "hach zahbentzil 'very fearsome' -> 'most just'", "tibil beob 'good ways/works' -> 'evil ways'", "pal 'young man' -> 'sick man'", "maix zihzabilobi 'they were not created' -> 'not begotten'", "bin ... tzic cob 'we shall honor them' -> 'this teaching ... means that the Father and the Son are to be honored'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the Maya closely with only a few small slips, while B gets several key clauses wrong (the penitent's question, the Spirit's reassurance, 'fearsome' rendered as 'just', 'good' rendered as 'evil') and leaves out the mention of hell."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 1, "omitted": ["the contrast 'not only because of what the sinner owes ... but also because of what is owed to the Giver of pardon' (má halili ... ua xan)", "the sense of promptness: calling on Christ as soon as one has fallen", "the comparison 'to fall and rise at once is not the same as to fall and stay lying'"], "added": ["\"and do not shelter you\"", "\"Let there be the beauty that comes to pass\"", "\"or the instrument of the one who is bound\"", "\"covering himself before another\"", "\"without desiring to be lost\"", "\"that move the deceiver\""], "mistranslated": ["Ah ɔául zàat-zah 'Giver of pardon' -> 'Tempter who frightens you away'", "má c payben xancunticéexi 'do not delay' -> 'we do not call upon you'", "záat-zah 'pardon' -> 'deceiver'", "Ahzáat-zah 'the Pardoner' -> 'the Deceiver'", "zalcunah 'contempt' -> 'dispensation'", "ƀin cħehnacen ti á uotzilil 'I will laugh at your misery' -> 'I will turn away from your poverty'", "ah keƀan talamé 'sinner in mortal sin' -> 'sinner in trouble'", "pecuolal Dios 'inspiration of God' -> 'stirring of God' (sense of the surrounding clauses lost)", "ú chucáanil mà nahmatic 'the great ingratitude' -> 'we do not consent to make ourselves guilty'", "c tħilicƀaéex ti le ú kahualil Dios 'you have rejected the grace of God' -> 'we set ourselves before God's house'", "Ahlohil 'the Savior' -> 'the one who judges'", "xocolilóob antahulóob 'the number of graces' -> 'the number of the helpers'", "makolal 'sluggishness' -> 'strength'", "c paymaéex 'let us hasten' -> 'as the beginning'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["hach mukanil hi tuntah 'very strong in trial' -> 'a firm trial' (slightly loose)", "iix ú paticuƀa yantal táan ú yichinticuƀa 'and remain lying, wallowing' -> 'turned aside and ready to depart' (loose)", "mix leti unchic ú zatic 'nor that he lost' — fine, but 'ú yacunah' rendered as 'his love' is acceptable; minor person shift 'we go to ask' vs 'you' follows the source's inconsistency"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B gives a coherent and largely accurate rendering of the homily on delaying confession, while A badly misreads key terms (pardon/Pardoner as 'deceiver/Tempter', contempt as 'dispensation') and much of it is incoherent."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["or a physician who, through carelessness, does not save a life", "using tools or instruments"], "mistranslated": ["tzicbenil (respect) -> \"faithfulness\"", "le yuntzilóob y le palilóob (masters and servants) -> \"the fathers and the children\"", "le palilóob y le yumtzilóob (servants and masters) -> \"the children and their parents\"", "Hebic máax cú meyah ti Dios ti laóobé (as one who serves God in them) -> \"As each one who works for God, all of them\"", "báax cú uetħic chucanil éma leti má cimzah (what does 'thou shalt not kill' forbid) -> \"what does it forbid, and what is the guilt that comes from killing\"", "cú zalcunahtic (mistreats/despises) -> \"binds\"", "uaix ti ú ah pocħil má tu záat zicé (or does not forgive the one who offended him) -> \"or a physician who, through carelessness, does not save a life\"", "Yan ú chucanil ti leitió ú yánalóob nuculóob ti cimzah (are there other ways of killing) -> \"Do those who kill using tools or instruments bear guilt in this?\"", "táan ú ɔabal kazil ɔilib (giving bad example) -> \"grave punishment is given\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["hebic le iglesia y Cristo (as the Church with Christ) -> \"as Christ loves the Church\" (slightly reworded)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the standard catechism sense of each question and answer (masters and servants, not forgiving one's offender, bad example), while A misreads several key terms and makes up content such as the physician."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["the merchants were there so worshippers coming from afar could easily find what to buy and offer (rendered as garbled 'were set to go out and seek everywhere')", "the reverence of the place and the hearers' devotion asking that much stay hidden (rendered incoherently)"], "added": ["\"behind them was stirred\"", "\"the good instrument of the pity of the town\"", "\"whether you know it as a stirring or otherwise\""], "mistranslated": ["sheep, young cattle (tamanóob, mehen uacxóob) -> 'those who sold, the small doves'", "ticħ (offering) -> 'sell/trade'", "Ahzáat-zah (offended Savior) -> 'Tempter'", "In heláancuntah ƀahun (he was greatly angered) -> 'I changed how great'", "ƀin anac … (things offered) -> 'the goods'", "with blows and kicks (loxóob, ni yocóob) -> 'to all who stood before them'", "Jesus went after them shouting and rebuking (tu pach … acam … tzeectic) -> 'behind them was stirred, and spoke'", "what should be only a house of prayer -> 'what in truth had been the house of prayer'", "irreverence (má tzicil) as very grave sin held by the Savior -> 'the Tempter was there from all that was not good'", "nucul (thought/idea) -> 'instrument'", "truth cannot be obscured -> 'may not be made to shine in vain'", "kulté (to worship) -> 'to be seated'", "hatzul (offense/division) -> 'driving out'", "tanlahul (attention, care) -> 'attend' with garbled sense", "Cóonéex tioklal hatzulilóob (let us take them point by point) -> 'Let us go, then, for the sake of the driving out'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["má unchac ù macunzaƀal (cannot be hidden/covered) -> 'not to be tolerated' (looser sense)", "napzah uaiix … kaholticéex rendered as 'through custom or through ignorance' (plausible but somewhat interpretive)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B is a coherent and largely accurate rendering of the Temple-cleansing sermon.
